observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon DSLR body with the Canon logo on the front and a lens attached; the lens front ring text is partially visible but not fully readable.
Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with the rear LCD and buttons; a purple/blue reflection is visible on the screen area (screen condition/brightness not verifiable).
Photo 2 shows the top/right side of the camera with the marking “EOS 800” visible on the body; the lens is attached and appears to be a standard zoom.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: UK origin and “neat” condition are not verifiable from the photos. The lens focal range (18-55mm) is not clearly readable in the provided images.
Photo 2 shows “EOS 800” marking consistent with EOS 800D.
Lens text in photo 0/2 is not clear enough to confirm the exact 18-55mm specification.

risks.risk: Lens model/spec may not be 18-55mm (could be different Canon kit lens or a non-matching lens).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the lens barrel text showing the exact focal length (e.g., “18-55mm”) and lens model name/number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Canon kit zoom with unknown exact spec.

risks.risk: Camera condition may be worse than “neat” (scratches, dents, worn buttons, or sensor/lens fungus). Photos don’t show sensor or internal condition.
risks.proof: Photo/video of: (1) sensor test shot of a blank wall at f/8, (2) lens front element close-up for fungus/haze, (3) a quick view of all ports/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cosmetic wear and unknown sensor/lens health.

risks.risk: Shutter count / usage level unknown; could be high.
risks.proof: Screenshot/photo from the camera or a shutter-count app/site showing shutter actuations (or a service report).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-usage used unit (worst-case within typical used market).

risks.risk: Functionality unknown (AF, focus accuracy, buttons, autofocus motor, HDMI/USB, flash).
risks.proof: Short video showing autofocus on a moving subject + playback of a recorded clip + flash test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume basic functions only.

risks.risk: Screen may have issues (dead pixels, scratches, brightness problems).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the LCD at full brightness on a white screen and a dark screen (or a video pan showing uniformity).
risks.if_unproven: Price as screen condition unknown (assume possible wear).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the lens barrel text confirming “18-55mm” (and lens model).
A sensor test shot (blank wall) at f/8 and a close-up of the lens front element for fungus/haze.
Short video tests: autofocus on moving subject, playback of a recorded clip, and flash firing.
response.reason: The body appears to be a Canon EOS 800D (photo 2), but the key pricing drivers—exact lens spec (18-55mm) and true condition/functionality (sensor, lens health, shutter count, AF)—are not verifiable from these photos alone.
